attempts.text:
Car 2 makes all five sorties from Kalika hospital and returns there each time. Car 1 stays idle. Tarkeshwar, Thakre and the second group at Tadi are deferred, since rescuing them costs more driving than their penalties. The plan avoids the flooded Thakre–Tadi and Tarkeshwar–Dhunche roads and the washed-out Myagang–Dhunche bridge. I treated the old man at Tadi as elderly, since he is not described as injured.
